lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance circular clusters arranged in a quasi-rectilinear grid posterior to the branchial region, extending across the mid-lateral flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with horizontal rows of high-luminance blobs, forming distinct anchor points across the lateral surface.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Multiple longitudinal ridges are visible on the upper flank, exhibiting a sharp vertical luminance gradient with high intensity on the dorsal-facing edge and shadow on the ventral-facing edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Distal tip of the left pectoral fin shows a cluster of high-intensity white pixels indicative of scarring or depigmentation; a remora is attached to the ventral surface.
other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced caustic patterns caused by surface light refraction create a network of high-intensity wavy lines across the dorsal and lateral surfaces.
